provenance.note: A research-derived policy-subject vocabulary; grouping and short descriptions are original director synthesis, not a national official taxonomy, prevalence survey, legal power grant, fixed law bank or proof of implemented effects. Definition keys are independent of display labels. Based on the selected 14-domain answer; contents only, with no runtime weights.
